diagnosis: The employee payroll search handler queries an isolated PostgreSQL pool selected by req.params.companyId without checking whether the user belongs to that company or holds HR permissions. Any employee can search compensation and bank account details of staff in any company hosted on the multi-tenant cluster.
exploit_request:
GET /api/payroll/employees/search/comp_enterprise_tech_99?query=Executive HTTP/1.1
Host: hr.saas.internal:9105
Authorization: Bearer <regular_employee_token>
Accept: application/json
